title: On Scalable Platforms, an administrator with permissions to edit and install the Access Control Policy and NAT rules…
description: CVE-2026-120490 is a vulnerability affecting Scalable Platforms where an administrator with permissions to edit and install Access Control Policy and NAT rules can create a NAT rule that redirects traffic to the Gateway's Sync interface. This bypasses the built-in Sync protection and could allow the administrator to execute operating system commands and write files on the Gateway with superuser privileges. The vulnerability has a low CVSS score of 3.8 and does not have known exploits in the wild. No patch or remediation information is provided.
